text_block_list.text:
After finishing treatment
for an injured Super Creek—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Umm... if you stare at me like that,
I'm going to get embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I assure you, it's no act~.
As long as I take it easy, it won't be so—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Geez, staring at me again...
You shouldn't tease me like that, no no.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, it hurts a bit,
but not enough to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Are you... sure?
choice_data_list: Still, I can't help but worry.
If you're lying, I'm gonna cry, you know?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Are you... sure?
choice_data_list: If this is a lie, I'm gonna cry, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
I shouldn't make you worry.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I feel bad making it all about me,
...but I'll pamper myself just a little.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer.
...Will you stay by my side until I heal?
Super Creek smiled so as not to cause any worry, seemingly enduring the pain.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh, you shouldn't do that!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer.
The truth is, it really hurts a lot.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, whatever shall I do... Because of me,
Trainer has to go through such hardship—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Augh! O-Ouch...

"After calming down the flustered and panicked Super Creek,
I gently looked after her."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh... fufu, Trainer, you really are something.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If I made them cry,
I must take full responsibility and comfort them.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Give a big hug, and then... yes,
for that very reason, I need to get well soon.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...Such a sweet Trainer.
Thank you very much♪"

After receiving proper care, Super Creek
happily patted my head, giving me a gentle "there, there."
